basics.name: Nur Hossain Raton
basics.label: Software Engineer at OpenRefactory, Inc.
basics.summary: Software Engineer with experience building production-grade full-stack applications and security-focused backend systems. Experienced in CVE root cause analysis by analyzing commit histories and applying LLM-based code understanding techniques. Familiar with system design, RESTful APIs, database design, LLM API integration, RAG, and modern full-stack development using Next.js, Node.js, Python, and PostgreSQL.

work.name: OpenRefactory, Inc.
highlights: Led the implementation of a core security feature—Root Cause Analysis—for identifying functions directly responsible for CVEs by analyzing commit histories across multiple sources.
Applied LLM-based code understanding to correlate commits, functions, and vulnerability severity, improving the accuracy of package security assessment.
Contributed to multiple full-stack features for the Project Clean Beach product, working across frontend, backend, and database layers.
Worked with Next.js, Python, and PostgreSQL to develop production-grade security and full-stack features.

work.name: ACS Future School
highlights: Designed and implemented end-to-end features including threaded comments, notifications, ticketing systems, and admin dashboards using Next.js and PostgreSQL.
Designed scalable REST APIs and optimized PostgreSQL schemas to support growing user and admin workflows.
Collaborated with stakeholders to translate product requirements into production-ready features.
Worked with Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL.
